sources.finding: Built-in Identity passkey registration and authentication, explicit RP/origin configuration, optional attestation verification, resource bounds and protected temporary state. Reuse the framework rather than custom WebAuthn crypto.

Pinned approved runtime source. Inspect ceremony-only APIs and their state lifecycle; preserve Tunner authoritative session issuance instead of introducing an unrelated Identity application-cookie session.
Ceremony-only assertion produces a verified user/passkey result. Persist updated framework passkey metadata through supported Identity storage APIs.

Level3 Recommendation,25 August2026, verified separately from the newer editor/draft URL. Apply challenge, RP/origin, type, user-presence/verification and signature/counter/backup validation to the supported ceremonies.
Final SP800-63B-4 publication July2025; use final guidance already referenced by FRD17, not superseded draft material.
Assurance depends on verified factors/capabilities and policy. A passkey name alone does not grant AAL2/3; syncable credentials cannot meet AAL3. Do not invent Tunner policy values.

decision: RESOLVED_EXISTING_ADR_0006: use approved .NET10.0.13 Identity and its existing schema3 passkey store; no new FIDO dependency, cryptographic verifier or identity/session authority.
boundary: Primary-source R&D is not Security/Product approval of RP domains, origins, assurance mappings, retention or deployment configuration. Those remain explicit trusted approved inputs; local synthetic fixtures cannot activate production.
